title: BW/BI Business Analyst
text: BW/BI Business Analyst at Peoplebank Australia NSW (Sydney, ; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). Applicant MUST be an Australian citizen or Australian PR holder Duration: 6 months Location: SYdney CBD KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES: • Conducting functional requirements workshops for BI reporting. • Work with client and vendor groups to gather requirements and develop reporting and analytics solutions. • Work with other streams to determine reporting requirements. • Agreeing reporting scope for BI deployment phases with key stakeholders. • Owns and maintains the BW/BI functional design templates. • Documenting functional requirements for BI reports. • Undertaking integration testing and co-ordinating User Acceptance Testing for BI reporting. • Working closely with BW/4HANA developers to integrate different presentation layer technologies. • Identify, communicate and remediate data quality errors and calculation errors. • Identify and document risks and issues. • Ensure all analysis and development work is thoroughly documented. EXPERIENCE AND KNOWLEDGE: Essential • A minimum of 3 years’ experience in delivering SAP reporting and analytics solutions in large scale complex SAP environments. • A minimum of 8 years’ experience in ICT Project Business Analysis with most of this working with Business Intelligence. • Demonstrated expertise in the development of reporting and analytics solutions in SAP BW, ideally BW/4HANA. • Demonstrated expertise in developing and documenting impact analyses, options analyses, and functional specifications to support requirements gathering and build phases. • Experience with SAP Activate agile methodology or other agile project methodologies. • Experience with BI report testing and managing business user testing. • Experience with iterative report development approaches for agile style report development. • Demonstrated experience in supporting multiple senior stakeholder groups. • Demonstrated knowledge of SAP - FI/CO, PS, and HR transformation processes. • Experience in the development of reporting and analytics solutions in SAP BW HANA. • Good interpersonal skills and a team player. Desirable • Experience in NSW government agencies. • The ideal candidate will also have experience with Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, or QlikView. For more information or a confidential discussion, please contact Tim Moynihan quoting reference: 183453. Please click the apply button.
